notes: Band C (QS 2027 ranks 26-50), first pass of computer-related undergraduate and taught-masters programmes. Coverage is partial, not exhaustive: about 2-7 core programmes per institution (63 total). No institution stats (total students, ratios, percentages) were verified from official pages in this session, so all stats are null; only two founded years were verified (Fudan 1905, Zhejiang 1897). No campus photos or membership tags were verified. Fees left null/unknown are genuine unknowns: KCL CS BSc (aggregator figures GBP 42,900 / GBP 30,988 conflict), McGill (aggregator C$64,786 / C$65,167.50 not used), HKUST UG (only a stale 2021 figure), PSL (official figures EUR 254 vs EUR 3,941 conflict), IPP DataAI (fee document figures not attributable per programme), SNU/Yonsei/Tokyo/UBC/Columbia MS/UCLA MS/Northwestern/Princeton/Toronto (no fee on retrieved official pages). Stale fee figures are flagged in the fee notes (Zhejiang CE 2023 handbook; Zhejiang Automation 2022/2024 pages; HKUST UG 2021 document; SNU 2015 guide not used). Thin records: SNU and Yonsei graduate programmes (taught-master's classification could not be confirmed from retrieved pages), Tokyo EPIIP (2024 guide, old cycle), PSL (no undergraduate computer programme verified). Deadlines omitted where sources conflicted or were stale: UCLA UG (UC window 1 Oct-30 Nov vs Samueli page Oct 1-Dec 1), UBC MDS (FAQ says 'typically January 31', not a stated 2027-cycle deadline), HK PolyU UG (only 2026/27-cycle dates), SNU/Yonsei (old-cycle dates only). Northwestern MLDS: regular deadline 15 January 2027 recorded; scholarship-priority deadline is 1 December 2026. Northwestern MSAI: final deadline 15 April 2027 recorded; recommended deadline is 15 December. Toronto MScAC is the only programme with application_status 'open' (official page states 'Fall 2027 applications are now open').
